question: During which span of the rite should the hand-throb be observed?
premises: The hand-throb is the sign in question.
Observation begins from the taking of the eye-band.
Observation continues up to the taking of the tooth-stick.
inference: The hand-throb should be watched throughout the interval from removing the eye-band to taking the tooth-stick.
plain_english: One should observe the hand-throb from the moment the eye-band is taken, all the way up to the taking of the tooth-stick.
